verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review and agent product, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, the pack only documents Qodo exposing its own Agentic Toolbox skills to other agents through MCP (server role). Nothing shows users plugging third-party MCP servers into Qodo for it to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
